comparison.objective: Tune and lock a shock absorber vs center a captive crossbar so its carrier can enter a low dock.
comparison.physical_skill: Hex-tool torque, collar rotation, moved-socket reacquisition, and iterative cycling vs manipulating a captive prismatic bar and docking the linked carrier.
comparison.success_condition: Two safe repeated stops with no overload or collar drift vs bar centered, carrier fully docked, linkage consistent, both hands released, and end state stable.
comparison.reason: Both manipulate captive mechanisms, but crossbar centering/docking does not test a fastener lock or response-based damping adjustment.
